title: Maximum angular velocity
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the final answer ω₀ = √(μg/R).

title: Centripetal force balance
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion, equating maximum static friction to the required centripetal force.

title: Minimum friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the final answer μ' = (2/3)μ.

title: Post-slip kinematics
description: Important: Uses kinematics (v² = 2ax) for constant deceleration on the table after the object leaves the disk.

title: Geometry of displacement
description: Important: Correctly calculates the radial displacement on the table as x = √((1.25R)² - R²) = 0.75R.

title: Velocity at disk edge
description: Important: Relates the angular velocity at slipping to the linear velocity using v = ω₀R.

title: Incorrect force direction
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of the frictional force on the table (should be opposite to velocity, providing deceleration).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes an algebraic sign error in combining equations or omits/drops necessary units (g, R).
